question: Which company agreed to acquire Arize?

hits.title: Arize and Dynatrace: making the World's AI Work.
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2026-08-13 | $915 million] Dynatrace acquired Arize AI, Inc for $915M on Aug 13th '26. Today Arize is announcing the signing of a definitive agreement for the acquisition of Arize by Dynatrace to accelerate that proposition.
hits.summary: Dynatrace acquired Arize AI, Inc for $915M on Aug 13th '26.

hits.title: Acuity Brands to Acquire Horticultural Brand From Current
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2024-01-01 | $1 billion] Acuity Brands, Inc acquired Arize AI, Inc for $1B on Jan 1st '24. Acuity Brands, North America's largest lighting company, has agreed to acquire the Arize(R) family of horticulture lighting products from rival Current Lighting Solutions, a $1 billion competitor in commercial lighting.
hits.summary: Acuity Brands, Inc acquired Arize AI, Inc for $1B on Jan 1st '24.
